name: Illhveli, Taumafiskur
body:
TAUMAFISKUR
CR 16

This massive coal?black whale has an immense tail and pale bridle-like markings along its jaws. Its domed forehead rises above void-like eyes that gleam unnervingly.

XP 76,800
N Colossal outsider (aquatic, evil, illhveli, native)
Init +6; blindsight 120 ft. (underwater only), darkvision 60 ft., deathwatch, true seeing; Perception +22

DEFENSE

AC 31, touch 4, flat-footed 29 (+2 Dex, +27 natural, –8 size)
hp 246 (17d10+153)
Fort +16, Ref +14, Will +14
DR 15/good; Immune cold, pressure damage from deep water; Resist electricity 10, sonic 10; SR 27
Weaknesses spawn of elsewhere

OFFENSE

Speed swim 40 ft.
Melee bite +27 (4d6+27 plus grab) and tail slap +22 (4d6+9)
Ranged blasphemous jet +11 (2d8+9 plus nausea and push)
Space 30 ft.; Reach 30 ft.
Special Attacks blasphemous jet, capsize, fast swallow, push (blasphemous jet, 20 ft.), swallow whole (6d6+18 damage, AC 23, 24 hp)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 17th; concentration +21)

Constant—deathwatch, true seeing
3/day—confusion (DC 18), control water, greater dispel magic
1/day—control weather, discern location, vortex (DC 21)

STATISTICS

Str 46, Dex 14, Con 29, Int 8, Wis 15, Cha 11
Base Atk +17; CMB +43 (+45 bull rush); CMD 55 (57 vs. bull rush)
Feats Awesome Blow, Diehard, Endurance, Great Fortitude, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack
Skills Intimidate +24, Perception +22, Sense Motive +22, Survival +22, Swim +46
Languages Aquan, Common (can’t speak)
SQ amphibious

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Blasphemous Jet (Su)

Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, a taumafiskur can spew a burst of foul liquid from its blowhole with astounding force and accuracy. This jet is ranged touch attack with a range of 240 feet with no range increment, underwater the jet’s range decreases to 40 feet. A target hit by the jet is subject to the taumafiskur’s push ability and must succeed at a DC 27 Fortitude save or be nauseated for 1d4 rounds. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Spawn of Elsewhere (Su)

Despite being a native outsider, a taumafiskur’s essence is so obscenely unnatural that this illhveli is treated as if it were a summoned extraplanar creature. This makes the taumafiskur vulnerable to spells such as magic circle against evil and dismissal. If a taumafiskur is banished, it is not transported to another plane but instead returns from the darkest ocean depths at least a day later.

ECOLOGY

Environment cold and temperate oceans
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

Taumafiskurs are also called ‘bridle-fish’ due to the white stripes that extend from their mouths and eyes, giving the appearance of a bridle. They are vicious, spiteful, and vindictive, overturning boats, tearing them apart with their teeth or smashing them with their tails. Taumafiskurs have excellent memories and hold a lifelong grudge against anyone who escapes them. These illhveli can use powerful magic to track these escapees.

One tale tells of a priest who eluded a taumafiskur, but from then on was unable to go anywhere near the coastline without the vengeful creature appearing.

Taumafiskur do have a small vulnerability, spells that ward off or bind summoned creatures can work against these illhveli. There are several accounts of a boat captain skilled in spellcasting, who dove overboard while hurling a series of mystical components from a small bag and succeeded at repelling a taumafiskur.
